---
title: Engineering Skills
description: A small, maintained collection of engineering and agent-workflow skills by butterlyn.
---

Practical instructions for engineering work, kept with the files an agent needs
to use them. The [GitHub repository](https://github.com/butterlyn/engineering-skills)
is the source of truth; this site publishes the same authored content through
Great Docs.

The MVP contains **verify-a-change**, a clearly labelled demonstration skill for
turning a change's acceptance criteria into evidence. It includes its own
reference template and needs no other installed skill.

```bash
npx skills add butterlyn/engineering-skills --skill verify-a-change --agent codex
```

You can also install from this project's documentation URL. See
[Installation](user-guide/installation.qmd) for all four target agents, discovery, and
individual or collection installation.

Use [Verify a change](user-guide/verify-a-change.qmd) for examples and limitations, and
[Contributing](user-guide/contributing.qmd) to add your next authored skill. The
[combined Pack](user-guide/curation.qmd) is a separate, pending curation entry point;
Matt Pocock's content is linked upstream and is never hosted here.
